# datadog_integration_anthropic_usage_and_costs_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Anthropic Usage and Costs, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `anthropic_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--anthropic_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--anthropic_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.anthropic_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Anthropic Admin API key with permission to read usage and cost data, or an Analytics API key with the `read:analytics` scope. Generate an Admin API key in the Anthropic Console under **Settings > Admin Keys**. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Anthropic Admin API key with permission to read usage and cost data, or an Analytics API key with the `read:analytics` scope. Generate an Admin API key in the Anthropic Console under **Settings > Admin Keys**. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `anthropic_cloud_cost_metrics` (Attributes) Anthropic costs by model, workspace, and service tier, in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). Requires Cloud Cost Management on your Datadog organization. Without it, this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_cloud_cost_metrics))

Read-Only:

- `anthropic_usage_metrics` (Attributes) Anthropic usage metrics, such as input, output, and cache token consumption by model, workspace, and service tier. With an Analytics API key, usage is also broken down by user, product, context window, inference geography, and speed. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, which is why it appears in responses only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_usage_metrics))
- `claude_daily_usage_dora_metrics` (Attributes) Daily Claude usage data used for DORA Metrics. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, which is why it appears in responses only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--claude_daily_usage_dora_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_cloud_cost_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.anthropic_cloud_cost_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.

Read-Only:
